description: The Music pop-up's speaker buttons (2026-11-03). Points both music cards at the chosen speaker (input_text.music_speaker) and, like a device picker, moves what was on the previous one there: Music Assistant's queue is transferred, still playing if it was playing, paused if it was paused. Nothing moves when the previous speaker was idle. A Kitchen or HomePod pick while the Whole House group plays counts as the group: their own queues are empty then, and moving one once wiped the group's song (2026-11-03). Moving onto the Family Room Stereo runs the Pioneer warm-up as usual.

variables.current: {{ 'media_player.whole_house' if picked in ['media_player.kitchen', 'media_player.homepod'] and is_state('media_player.whole_house', ['playing', 'paused']) else picked }}

if.value_template: {{ speaker != current and current.startswith('media_player.') and states(current) in ['playing', 'paused'] }}
